claim_supported: Ventura County is currently planning to close Santa Paula Hospital, and the proposed option does not include ER services.
evidence_text: Santa Paula Hospital won't meet new seismic safety standards required by 2030, and Ventura County is currently planning to close it. The county is trying to figure out what it will do to meet the Santa Clara River Valley's future health care needs.
limitations: The county is still far from making a final decision on a plan, and the replacement model discussed in the article does not include ER services.
pressure_reason: Closing the hospital would remove local inpatient and emergency access unless a replacement plan is completed.
pressure_summary: Ventura County is considering closure of Santa Paula Hospital while replacement options remain unresolved.
review_reason: Historical Care Line backfill for Santa Paula Hospital planned closure.
summary_or_snippet: Ventura County is planning to close Santa Paula Hospital as it weighs replacement options; the proposed option does not include ER services.
title: Santa Paula Hospital will close with no plans for a replacement
